At 9a.m. 15.9.39 the undersigned interviewed Mr.Lu
Chi Chen at his home and learned that he had made
enquiries among the supporters of both the National
Government and the Reformed Government. He was given
to understand by the former that he was in good standing
and his removal from office was not contemplated. From
the latter, through Mr.Fu Shi Yueh, he learned that none
of the various factions desired him to leave Shanghai or
had entertained any suggestion of assassinating him;
however, the actions of certain pro-Teng Ching Wei groups
who were described as "rascals", could not be guaranteed
as their positions were held mostly by actions showing
their loyalty to the movement.

It is worth noting that whilst Mr.Lu Chi Chen and
Mr.Fu Shi Yueh are politically opposed, they are good
friends in private life.

1939年9月15日上午9时，签署人在其家中会见了鲁继曾（Lu Chi Chen）先生，得知他已向国民政府和维新政府的支持者进行了查询。前者向他表明，他地位稳固，并未考虑将其免职。通过傅式說（Fu Shi Yueh）先生，他从后者那里得知，各派系均不希望他离开上海，也没有任何刺杀他的提议；但是，某些被描述为“流氓”的亲汪精卫团体的行动无法得到保证，因为他们的地位主要是通过显示对该运动忠诚的行动来维持的。

值得注意的是，虽然鲁继曾先生和傅式說先生在政治上对立，但他们在私人生活中是好朋友。

Concerning the establishment of the Great China
University, Mr. Lu Chi Chen stated that it was founded

and Mr. Fu Shi Yueh (傅式說) who is also known as Tsoo

in America and the last in Japan.

Until the outbreak of Sino-Japanese hostilities
in August 1937, the university was situated at the
intersection of Chapei and Great Western Roads. The
Principal was Mr. Tang Teh Chun (王伯羣). The
undersigned was one of the secretaries and also a member
of the Shanghai Municipality Bureau of Education. After
the outbreak the university moved into the interior. Mr.
Ou Yuan Hwai, Mr. Wang Chi Wei and Mr. Lu Chi Chen went
with it, but Mr. Fu Shi Yueh stayed in Shanghai.

The university was re-established in Kweiyang,
Kweichow Province, with Mr. Ou Yuan Hwai as Principal.

the Nationalist Government's Legislative Yuan.

关于日志第1号，鲁继曾先生（Lu Chi Chen）向本人透露了一些他认为必须视为绝密的信息。

关于大夏大学的建立，鲁继昌先生陈述说，该校由三位来自厦门大学的教授于1924年创立，他们是欧元怀先生（Ou Yuan Hwai）、王祉伟先生（Wang Chu Wei）和傅式说先生（Fu Shi Yueh），后者又名竺隐（Tsoo Ying）。前两位在美国完成学业，最后一位在日本完成学业。

直到1937年8月中日敌对行动爆发前，该校位于闸北与大西路交汇处。校长是王伯群先生（Tang Teh Chun）。本人曾是秘书之一，也是上海市教育局成员。爆发后，大学迁往内地。欧元怀先生、王祉伟先生和鲁继昌先生随校迁移，但傅式说先生留在上海。

大学在贵州省贵阳重新建立，由欧元怀先生担任校长。王祉伟先生前往重庆，担任国民政府立法院成员。

To my little boy Chi Chen,

You frequently visited Shanghai and Kweiyang.
We have made investigation and know what you have done.
You, being a chief-secretary and a dean of an university,
have attempted to be a traitor, enticed students with money
to join your party, held up the management of the university,
kept in touch the bogus organisation and spoiled the war-
resistance. You were formerly the officer i/c of the
Education Bureau of Shanghai, and our Government has not
treat you badly. Why have you become crazy and changed your
mind? You have behaved so bad that we are very angry with
you. You had better leave Shanghai immediately and return
to Kweiyang, and you will then still be a professor of an
university, otherwise your deadbody would lie across a street.
Don't blame us for not having advised you before hand.

(Sd.) Iron & Blood Traitors-
Assassination Corp.
